title.narrative: TVaksjon 2022 - new drugs for neglected diseases (sleeping sickness and visceral leishmaniasis)

description.narrative:
DNDi is a virtual non-profit drug R&D organization set up in 2003 to develop new treatments against the most neglected communicable diseases. DNDi was established with support from Medesins sans Frontieres/Legen uten Grenser (MSF). MSF is the principal recipient of the TVAksjon in 2022. However, MSF does NOT accept financing from donor governments - and has asked the Norwegian government to provide this years "gift" to DNDi. Norad has previously supported DNDi from 2013 - 2017 with a total of 22M NoK (QZA-13/0335; PTA 1301381). This support was for development of new drugs in treatment of Sellping Sickness.
The grant was successful and new drugs have been developed and accepted. The current proposal form DNDi requests support for further development of treatment for sleeping sickness and visceral leishmaniasis - and for implementing these new medicines into use in national health systems. Hence this is an excellent follow up grant from previous support.
